<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix n: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix q: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

<urn:development:control> a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:property [ sh:minCount 1 ;
            sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
                            sh:minCount 1 ;
                            sh:path q:numericValue ],
                        [ sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> ;
                            sh:path q:unit ] ] ;
            sh:path n:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ],
        [ sh:minCount 1 ;
            sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:minCount 1 ;
                            sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> ;
                                            sh:path q:unit ],
                                        [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
                                            sh:minCount 1 ;
                                            sh:path q:numericValue ] ] ;
                            sh:path n:waterlineCaseDisplacement ] ] ;
            sh:path n:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ] ;
    sh:sparql [ sh:select "PREFIX q: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> SELECT $this WHERE { {  $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#upperIceWaterlineDisplacement>/q:numericValue ?r . $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase>/<https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement>/q:numericValue ?v . FILTER(?v > ?r)  } UNION {  $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#upperIceWaterlineDisplacement>/q:numericValue ?r . FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase>/<https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement>/q:numericValue ?v . FILTER(?v = ?r) }  } }" ] ;
    sh:targetClass n:ship .

<END_SHACL>
